title: Live behavioural runs no longer exist
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0088 no longer matches the current design.
decision: 0142 and 0154 removed live behavioural runs: agents are judged in use and the check calls no model. Rules for running them lapse.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
